exposure: TURIP procedure (Tourniquet of uterine isthmus, uterus inversion, placental detachment by sharp dissection)
cohort: A 38-year-old woman, conceived by in vitro fertilization (IVF), who was unexpectedly diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum during delivery.
finding: The TURIP procedure is useful to preserve fertility in unpredicted placenta accreta spectrum without previa.
mod_finding: A cesarean section was performed for fetal breech presentation, which led to the unexpected encounter with placenta accreta spectrum.
